purpose: Defines review gates for records where language is tied to forms, medical orders, legal jurisdiction, ICU protocols, organ procurement, or assisted-dying law.

gates.name: Jurisdiction lock
gates.requirement: Public rendering must name jurisdiction limits or remain nonlocal and route to official local sources.

gates.name: Clinical noninstruction
gates.requirement: No procedural, ventilator, medication, dosing, oxygen, feeding, hydration, or symptom-management instruction may appear in lay surfaces.

gates.name: Capacity, surrogate, and values protection
gates.requirement: Render capacity, authority, interpreter/access needs, and patient-values language before family preference or institutional convenience.

gates.name: Organ donation conflict-of-interest separation
gates.requirement: Public text must not imply organ recovery teams decide withdrawal or declare death; role separation and family questions must be explicit.

gates.name: Suicide-safe and means-safe messaging
gates.requirement: No method instructions, romanticization, eligibility counseling, or crisis-adjacent framing. Route distress to local emergency/crisis support.

gates.name: Anti-abandonment language
gates.requirement: Terms limiting interventions must be accompanied by care-continuity language and cannot imply the person is being discarded.

release_rule: Any record with an institutional gate requires at least one clinical reviewer and, where applicable, legal/policy or ethics reviewer before public use.
